summary:
After deciding the cart had items, the agent did not open the cart before looking for the “Empty cart” button. That button belongs on the cart page, not the shop page.
Update the flow so that, after checking whether the cart contains items, the agent opens the cart page before clicking “Empty cart”; if it is already empty, proceed directly to the three required shirt clicks.
one_liner: The agent tried to find the cart-only “Empty cart” control while still on the shop page.

verdict.root_cause: After deciding the cart had items, the agent did not open the cart before looking for the “Empty cart” button. That button belongs on the cart page, not the shop page.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the terminal outcome. It was still at http://localhost:3000/ when it concluded the cart had items at step 0-6, then immediately failed at step 0-7 because it searched that shop page for a cart-page button. The recorded navigation to the home page at step 0-2 and the terminal message explicitly identifying the “current shop page” support this; there is no evidence that the application failed to render the control on the cart page.
verdict.bug_title: Agent searched for cart control on the shop page
verdict.suggestion: Update the flow so that, after checking whether the cart contains items, the agent opens the cart page before clicking “Empty cart”; if it is already empty, proceed directly to the three required shirt clicks.
